components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default high-clarity action for forms and next steps.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); color: var(--color-paper, oklch(1 0 0)); padding: 12px 20px; font: 500 14px/1.25 'Geist Variable', Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .01em; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--color-paper, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(.985); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(1 0 0), 0 0 0 5px oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25); }

components.name: Watercolor Hero Button
components.description: A violet action reserved for the established watercolor context.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A quiet 48px form control with a crisp focus state.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Adresă de email<input class="ds-input" type="email" placeholder="nume@exemplu.ro"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); font: 500 14px/1.25 'Geist Variable', Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height: 48px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, oklch(0.923 0.003 48.717)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-paper, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 16px/1.5 'Geist Variable', Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(1 0 0), 0 0 0 5px oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25); }

components.name: Quiet Alert

components.name: Guided Reflection Choice
components.description: A native radio option with a full-row selectable surface.
components.css: .ds-reflection-choice { display: flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, oklch(0.923 0.003 48.717)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-paper, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); padding: 20px; font: 400 18px/1.55 'Geist Variable', Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-reflection-choice:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); } .ds-reflection-choice:active { transform: scale(.985); } .ds-reflection-choice:has(input:checked) { background: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); color: var(--color-paper, oklch(1 0 0)); } .ds-reflection-choice:has(input:focus-visible) { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(1 0 0), 0 0 0 5px oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25); }

components.css: .ds-area { max-width: 360px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line, oklch(0.923 0.003 48.717)); padding: 16px; } .ds-area-image { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--color-watercolor-wash, oklch(0.97 0.001 106.424)), var(--color-brand-violet-soft, oklch(0.811 0.111 293.571))); } .ds-area h3 { margin: 24px 0 0; color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.25)); font: 400 36px/1.05 "Playfair Display Variable", "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-area p { margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--color-quiet, oklch(0.553 0.013 58.071)); font: 400 16px/1.55 "Source Serif Pro", Georgia, serif; }

narrative.overview: DespreSine combines the structural discipline of a contemporary editorial product with the softness and humanity already present in its watercolor imagery. The approved shadcn preset b4vf0yLwvq supplies the exact Stone semantic palette, Violet chart ramp, Geist body type, Playfair Display headings, Nova styling, and medium radius. Duna remains a reference for spacing, open responsive grids, and systematic reuse—not for fintech motifs, dashboards, saturated product chrome, or generic component-library styling.
keyCharacteristics: Typography-led hierarchy with generous, deliberate whitespace.
White and warm off-white surfaces separated by one-pixel rules.
Violet appears where the watercolor identity already earns it.
Small pills are reserved for short kickers and states; primary actions stay compact rectangles.
Static Astro surfaces remain hydration-free; React is reserved for meaningful interaction.

rules.name: Violet Rarity
rules.body: Violet belongs to the established watercolor/reflection world; it does not become a generic accent on every control.

rules.name: Two-Voice
rules.body: Display serif carries reflection and identity; Geist carries action and practical clarity. Source Serif appears only where the composition is explicitly editorial.

rules.name: Open Grid
rules.body: Use whitespace and one-pixel rules to establish relationships before introducing a boxed surface.

rules.name: Functional Elevation
rules.body: A shadow must explain that a surface floats above the document; it is never a default decoration for content groups.

dos: Do preserve the watercolor artwork and editorial typography as the recognizable identity.
Do use semantic tokens and shared variants before adding one-off utility combinations.
Do keep static pages hydration-free and measure bundle impact when an interactive primitive is proposed.
Do use one-pixel rules, open grids, and generous spacing to create structure.
Do maintain 44–48px control targets, strong focus visibility, reduced motion, and reduced transparency fallbacks.
donts: Don't copy Duna's fintech language, dashboard patterns, metrics, or product chrome.
Don't introduce generic shadcn card grids, toasts, dialogs, or navigation components without a demonstrated need.
Don't turn every label or action into a pill.
Don't add gradients, glass, blur, or shadows outside the established watercolor or functional overlay context.
Don't fabricate testimonials, outcomes, metrics, credentials, prices, or clinical claims to fill a layout.
